info.name: Refine Feature
info.desc: Resume editing and refinement functionality with form-based input fields. Supports editing personal information, skills, work experience, and education. Uses real-time data synchronization with backend API and persistent template selection via localStorage.
info.tech: React, TypeScript, Material-UI, Form Management, API Integration, i18n, localStorage

detail.desc: Apply Fix button: Only shown if fix_suggestion exists and not already fixed
Mark as Fixed button: Always shown, toggles between Mark/Unmark state
Go to Edit button: Always shown for manual navigation to editor

feature.name: fix_tracking
feature.desc: Track which improvement points have been fixed
feature.implementation: - is_fixed flag from ImprovementPoint type - Mark as Fixed button calls analysisApi.markFixed() - Persisted in backend User.analysis_result JSONB - Triggers onFixMarked callback to reload analysis

feature.name: fixed_display_format
feature.desc: Special styling for fixed improvement points
feature.styling: - Green background (#f0fdf4) instead of white - Green left border (COLORS.success.main) - Reduced opacity (0.85) for subtle dimmed effect - Green "Fixed" badge overlay with CheckCircleIcon in top-right - Title text: strikethrough + green color (#15803d) - Description text: green color (#15803d) - Point indicator: green dot instead of severity color - Score impact: green color with checkmark prefix - Hide diff view when marked as fixed - Mark as Fixed button changes to green contained variant
